risk_register.description: If Workday API sandbox environment is unavailable, undocumented, or unstable during Phase 2, then UC7 (Retrieve Employee Data) cannot be tested, form pre-population cannot be validated, and Phase 2 integration work will be blocked, delaying go-live by 2–4 weeks minimum.
risk_register.trigger: Workday API sandbox access denied, documentation incomplete, or SLA violations during integration testing window (weeks 9–16)
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm Workday API sandbox availability, documentation completeness, and SLA in writing before T14 (Workday API integration design) begins; establish fallback manual data entry workflow if API unavailable
risk_register.contingency: Implement manual data entry form for new hire information; defer form pre-population to Phase 3; escalate to Workday account manager for priority support

risk_register.description: If the team lacks prior experience with Azure AD account provisioning and Graph API permissions are not pre-approved by Security, then UC4 (Provision IT Accounts) automation scope will be reduced to manual approval workflow, Phase 2 timeline will extend 2–3 weeks, and IT Director sign-off will be delayed.
risk_register.trigger: Team confirms no prior Azure AD provisioning experience, or Security denies Graph API permissions before T18 (Account provisioning design) begins
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm team Azure AD experience and obtain written Graph API permission approval from Security before T5 (Architecture & Design); schedule security review in week 1 if permissions not pre-approved
risk_register.contingency: Reduce UC4 scope to manual IT admin approval workflow; implement email notification to IT admin instead of automated account creation; defer full automation to Phase 3

risk_register.description: If stakeholders have not formally approved scope in writing, then scope creep will occur during Phase 2–3 sprints, competing priorities (nice-to-have features: chat bot, mobile app, LMS integration) will be added without timeline adjustment, and delivery will slip past the 2026-06-30 deadline.
risk_register.trigger: No written scope sign-off document from CEO, HR Director, and IT Director by end of week 1; or stakeholder requests to add chat bot, mobile app, or LMS integration during Phase 2 sprints
risk_register.mitigation: Obtain written scope approval from all three stakeholders (CEO, HR Director, IT Director) before T1 (Project Kickoff); establish formal change control process for Phase 2–3 sprints; document nice-to-have features as Phase 4 backlog items only
risk_register.contingency: Implement change control board; defer any out-of-scope feature requests to Phase 4; re-baseline timeline if scope additions approved

risk_register.description: If data retention policy for onboarding documents (I-9, W-4, direct deposit, audit logs) is not defined by Legal/Compliance before build, then database schema will be designed without retention logic, SOC 2 assessment will fail post-launch, and re-architecture will be required.
risk_register.trigger: Legal/Compliance does not provide written data retention policy by end of week 1; or SOC 2 assessment identifies missing retention controls during Phase 3 UAT
risk_register.mitigation: Schedule meeting with Legal/Compliance in week 1 to define retention policy for all document types and audit logs; document policy in writing before T3 (Requirements Finalization); include retention logic in database schema design (T5)
risk_register.contingency: Implement default 7-year retention for all documents (standard for I-9); add database migration script to backfill retention metadata; schedule post-launch SOC 2 remediation

risk_register.description: If e-signature service vendor is not contracted or Legal/Compliance has not pre-approved SOC 2 compliance for the vendor, then vendor selection and legal review will add 2–3 weeks, and Phase 2 document collection feature (UC2) will be delayed.
risk_register.trigger: E-signature vendor not named in brief; or Legal/Compliance compliance sign-off not obtained by end of week 1; or selected vendor fails SOC 2 assessment
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm e-signature vendor name and SOC 2 compliance status in writing from Legal/Compliance before T1; if not pre-approved, schedule vendor evaluation and legal review in week 1 (before T12 Document Collection Design)
risk_register.contingency: Identify backup e-signature vendor (DocuSign, Adobe Sign, HelloSign) with known SOC 2 compliance; defer e-signature feature to Phase 2 week 3 if vendor selection extends beyond week 1

risk_register.description: If the Product Manager or Backend Developer becomes unavailable during critical path execution (T1, T2, T3, T5, T9, T13, T17, T21, T25, T29), then the entire project timeline will slip, as these roles have zero slack and no backup is documented.
risk_register.trigger: PM or Backend Developer assigned to competing project, takes unplanned leave, or departs during Phase 1–3; or critical path task (T1, T2, T3, T5, T9, T13, T17, T21, T25, T29) is blocked waiting for PM or Backend Developer decision
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm PM and Backend Developer are 100% dedicated to this project through Phase 3 (week 16); identify backup PM and Backend Developer from resource pool; document escalation path for critical decisions
risk_register.contingency: Activate backup PM or Backend Developer immediately; re-baseline timeline if primary resource unavailable for >3 consecutive days; escalate to executive sponsor for resource reallocation

risk_register.description: If Phase 2 integration testing (weeks 9–16) encounters unexpected API issues, schema mismatches, or permission denials from Workday or Azure AD, then UAT (T21, week 17) will be compressed, defect remediation will extend into Phase 3, and go-live will slip past 2026-06-30.
risk_register.trigger: Integration testing reveals API rate limiting, schema incompatibility, or permission errors; or Workday/Azure AD SLA violations during Phase 2 testing window
risk_register.mitigation: Allocate 2-week buffer in Phase 2 for integration issue remediation (weeks 14–15); conduct API sandbox testing in week 8 before formal Phase 2 integration work; establish escalation path to Workday and Azure AD support
risk_register.contingency: Compress UAT scope to critical path use cases only (UC2, UC4, UC6); defer non-critical use case testing to Phase 3; extend Phase 3 timeline by 1 week if integration issues persist

risk_register.description: If Product Owner is not identified and available for sprint-level backlog prioritization during Phase 2–3 (weeks 9–20), then sprint planning will be delayed, scope decisions will be blocked, and adaptive sprint cycles will not function as designed.
risk_register.trigger: Product Owner not named in brief; or named Product Owner is part-time or shared with other projects; or Product Owner unavailable for sprint planning meetings (weeks 9, 12, 15, 18)
risk_register.mitigation: Identify and confirm Product Owner (likely HR Director or CEO delegate) in week 1; ensure Product Owner is available for 4 hours/week during Phase 2–3 sprints; document decision-making authority in writing
risk_register.contingency: Escalate backlog prioritization decisions to executive sponsor; defer sprint-level scope decisions to PM; compress sprint cycle to 2-week sprints if Product Owner availability is limited

risk_register.description: If SOC 2 compliance requirements are not fully scoped (audit logging, data encryption, access controls, retention policies), then system architecture will be incomplete, compliance assessment will fail post-launch, and remediation will require re-architecture.
risk_register.trigger: SOC 2 compliance requirements not detailed in requirements document by end of week 1; or compliance assessment (Phase 3, week 19) identifies missing controls not addressed in build
risk_register.mitigation: Schedule SOC 2 compliance workshop with Legal/Compliance in week 1; document all compliance requirements (audit logging, encryption, access controls, retention) in requirements before T3; include compliance checklist in architecture design (T5)
risk_register.contingency: Implement post-launch SOC 2 remediation plan; defer non-critical compliance controls to Phase 4; schedule external SOC 2 audit in Phase 4 with 4-week buffer

risk_register.description: If success criteria (80% task completion before day one, 50% HR time reduction, zero manual IT tickets, >4/5 satisfaction) are not measurable or tracked during Phase 3 UAT, then project success cannot be validated, and go-live decision will be delayed.
risk_register.trigger: Success criteria not operationalized into test cases by end of Phase 2; or UAT does not include measurement of task completion rate, HR time savings, or satisfaction survey
risk_register.mitigation: Define measurable success criteria in requirements (T3); create UAT test plan that validates each success criterion (T21); establish baseline HR time and satisfaction metrics before go-live
risk_register.contingency: Conduct post-launch measurement of success criteria; defer satisfaction survey to week 2 post-launch; implement HR time tracking in parallel with system launch
